name: Hana'zua
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua waits wounded on the canyon ridges for help from young Horde initiates.

sections.title: A Scout Fallen to Venom
sections.body: Above the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua lies wounded on the ridges. The Darkspear scout met Sarkoth, a vicious scorpid that stalks the cliffs. Its venomous sting nearly killed him. Unable to move or return to camp, he waits in the dust for passing recruits. He needs them to kill Sarkoth and carry word of his plight to the Den.

faq.answer: In the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Hana'zua is a wounded Darkspear troll scout. Beasts on the ridges ambushed and poisoned him.
Sarkoth struck Hana'zua down on the crags above the training grounds. The large scorpid's venom left him unable to move or return to safety.

faq.q: What does he ask travelers to do?
faq.answer: Hana'zua asks travelers to kill Sarkoth and bring back the beast's claw as proof. He also asks them to carry word of his condition to the instructors at the Den.

angles.text: As a Darkspear initiate beginning your journey in Durotar, you may find a wounded kinsman amid the dangers of local wildlife. Protect your new allies.
For the Horde, helping Hana'zua survive and avenge his wound is an early test of your loyalty and readiness to fight.
